specification_points.description: Convert between denary, binary, and hexadecimal number representations
Perform binary addition and subtraction; use two's complement for negative numbers
Understand overflow and its detection
Represent and manipulate binary fractions; understand fixed-point and floating-point formats
Understand normalisation of floating-point numbers; explain rounding errors and underflow/overflow
Know ASCII and Unicode character encoding; understand the need for Unicode
Describe how images are represented using pixels, bit depth, resolution, and colour depth
Describe how sound is represented using sampling rate, sample resolution, and the ADC process
Describe lossless and lossy compression; explain run-length encoding (RLE)
Describe LAN, WAN, and the Internet; distinguish between bus, star, and mesh topologies
Understand client-server and peer-to-peer models
Explain the purpose of protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP, SMTP, POP3
Describe the TCP/IP four-layer model; explain the role of each layer
Explain symmetric and asymmetric encryption; describe public and private key use
Describe digital certificates and digital signatures
Identify common security threats: malware, phishing, man-in-the-middle, SQL injection
Describe firewall types, intrusion detection, and other security measures
Describe the von Neumann architecture: ALU, CU, registers, buses
Explain the fetch-decode-execute cycle in detail
Understand factors affecting processor performance: clock speed, cores, cache, pipelining
Describe RISC vs CISC architectures; understand Harvard architecture
Distinguish between RAM and ROM; describe the memory hierarchy
Explain the purpose of cache memory (L1, L2, L3) and virtual memory
Compare primary, secondary, and tertiary storage; compare storage media (HDD, SSD, optical)
Describe the functions of an operating system: process management, memory management, file management
Explain process scheduling algorithms: round robin, shortest job first, priority scheduling
Understand interrupts and their role in processor management
Distinguish between assemblers, compilers, and interpreters
Describe the stages of compilation: lexical analysis, syntax analysis, semantic analysis, code generation, optimisation
Understand the role of a linker and a loader
